interface.title: Active Units (Unit Activity Filter), a Bokeh dashboard
interface.field: Systems neuroscience / extracellular electrophysiology (spike-sorted single units)
interface.stage_of_work: After spike sorting and curation, before downstream analysis: choosing which units respond to the stimulus
interface.what_it_is_for: Set thresholds on baseline and stimulus-evoked firing rates, rate differences and p-values, see live how many units pass, check single units in per-experiment raster plots, and export the passing unit IDs to CSV.

data.note: The bundled example dataset was loaded at startup. It has 100 units and 3 experiments: Exp1 (direction tuning), Exp3 (orientation tuning) and Exp5 (main protocol). Firing rates come from a pre-computed activity_summary.csv. Rasters show 30 trials per unit per experiment, from -1000 to 4000 ms around stimulus onset. The page has no file upload. Rule files and exports are read and written on the server under /work/app/example/activity.

tree.general: Pick out the recorded units that respond to the stimulus, and hand that list to later analysis
tree.specific: Filter 100 spike-sorted units by baseline and response firing-rate thresholds across Exp1/3/5, check them in rasters, and export the active unit IDs

features.name: Multi-measure range-slider filter with linked histograms and pass count
features.general: Set min/max bounds on several numeric measures plus a stepped significance cut-off, apply them, and see per-condition histograms of the surviving items with threshold lines drawn on them, along with a passing count and percentage
features.specific: Drag the Baseline, Response, Difference and Absolute-difference range sliders, step the P-value upper threshold (None/0.001/0.005/0.01/0.05/1.0), press Apply Filters, and read the 5×3 histogram grid with red dashed bounds and the SUMMARY 'Passing: N (x%)'
steps: Drag the min/max handles on one or more range sliders
Step the p-value threshold slider to a preset level
Press Apply Filters
Read the updated histograms (passing units only, red bound lines) and the Passing count
serves_tasks: Set lower and upper bounds on several measures plus a significance cut-off

Press Apply Filters and see the pass count and threshold lines change

features.name: Sortable item table driving a zoomable per-condition raster panel
features.general: Sort a table of items by any measure, click a row, and see the raw trial-by-trial event rasters for that item in every condition side by side, aligned to stimulus onset; optionally zoom into a time window to judge response latency
features.specific: Sort the unit table by Diff, click a unit row, and Bokeh rasters 'Unit N – Exp1/Exp3/Exp5' (30 trials, -1000..4000 ms, pink onset line) load lazily; each raster's toolbar offers Box Zoom, Wheel Zoom and Reset

Any confirmation or error message for Save Rules, Load Rules (including a missing file) or Export Units. None appeared on the page.
not_done: Load spike-sorted units and trial timing, and compute baseline vs. evoked rates. The browser interface has no upload or compute control. The test files (spike_times.npy, trials.csv, etc.) could not be given to the page.

Confirm the exported CSV and the saved my_rules.csv. Both are written on the server's disk, not downloaded, so I could not read them. Reloading my_rules.csv did restore the saved thresholds, which indirectly shows the save worked.
Exit button. I did not press it because it would probably shut down the Bokeh server and end the session.
Raster pan. After I clicked the Pan tool, the drag did not visibly move the Exp1 raster (screens/034.webp). I did not look into why.
Rasters for units that fail the filter. After Apply Filters the table lists only passing units, so a rejected unit cannot be clicked to see its raster unless the filters are loosened first.
Edge case: rules files do not store the P-value threshold. I set the P-value threshold to 1.0 and pressed Load Rules on my_rules.csv again; the p-value was not restored (screens/030.webp).
Edge case: loading a non-existent rules file (missing_rules.csv) is silently ignored, with no error shown (screens/033.webp).
